author: Rafinesque, 1810
status: 여름철새 수천 마리 · 텃새 수십 마리
summary: 우리나라에서는 제주도 일대에 사는 텃새로, 초원과 개울가 풀밭, 보리밭, 하천부지 등에서 지낸다. 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 다니며 활동 범위가 넓고, 곤충을 즐겨 먹는다. 번식기에 수컷은 둥지를 여러 개 지어 여러 암컷을 끌어들여 둥지마다 알을 낳게 하는데, 둥지는 볏과 식물 줄기를 거미줄로 엮은 컵 모양이며 5~8월에 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 국외에서는 유럽 남부와 아프리카, 아시아 남부, 여러 섬에 분포한다.

art.subject: Zitting Cisticola (Cisticola juncidis), adult in summer (May–August): crown buff-brown streaked blackish; face plain buff with a faint pale supercilium; hindneck buff with only fine streaks; mantle and back boldly streaked blackish-brown with pale buff to whitish feather edges; rump plain warm rufous-buff; wings brown with buff fringes; chin and upper throat white; lower throat and breast washed buff, the flanks warmer buff; belly white; tail brown, each feather with a black subterminal spot and a whitish tip, best seen from below; thin, slightly curved bill, brown above and pinkish below; pink legs.
art.pose: perched on a grass stem, side view
art.scene: Jeju Island grassland and barley field beside a stream in summer; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view clinging to a grass stem: black-streaked buff crown, plain buff face, white chin and upper throat, buff breast, white belly, short rounded tail, thin bill, pink legs
adult, seen from behind on a grass stem: buff hindneck, back boldly streaked blackish-brown with pale buff-white edges, plain rufous-buff rump, short tail with black-and-white feather tips
art.build: Tiny, short-winged grassland warbler, 12.5cm, clearly smaller than a sparrow, with a rounded body and a large head; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat. Bill slender, slightly decurved, shorter than the head. Legs pink and fairly strong for gripping grass stems. Wings short and rounded; at rest the wingtips reach only the base of the tail. Tail short, broad and rounded (graduated), each feather with a black subterminal spot and a whitish tip, best seen from below. Clings upright to grass stems; in the breeding season the male makes a high, bouncing song flight over the grass.
avoid: Do not give it a long tail; it is short and rounded, unlike a prinia or reed warbler.
Do not paint a plain, unstreaked back like a reed warbler (Acrocephalus); the back is boldly streaked.
Do not paint a dark eye-stripe or a bold face pattern; the face is plain buff.
Do not make it sparrow-sized or thick-billed.
